scope: GPU admission repair and new output lineage only
method: All prepared inputs, model, eight-view extraction math, features, and future evaluation semantics remain v1.

prepared_input.mode: read-only reuse; no copy or rewrite

wddm_gpu_gate.lock_policy: O_EXCL lock with random lease nonce; never auto-break a stale lock
process_queries: nvidia-smi full process table for PID->Type
wddm_gpu_gate.ignore_rule: Ignore a foreign row only when used_gpu_memory is literally [N/A], the same PID is typed G or C+G in the process table, and the full query path basename is in the frozen GUI allowlist.
wddm_gpu_gate.block_rule: Block numeric memory even for a GUI name; block pure C, unknown or missing type, unknown executable, and every malformed/other memory value.
wddm_gpu_gate.race_reduction: Repeat the foreign-process scan after CUDA free-memory initialization; ignore only this runner's PID.
wddm_gpu_gate.memory_gate: Require at least 6442450944 free bytes before model load.

not_in_scope: No GPU work in CPU stages.
No gold/label/test read in this runner.
No v1 artifact modification or overwrite.
Scoring remains a later separately reviewed stage after caches freeze.
